source: NASA POWER daily API (PRECTOTCORR, community AG), https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/services/api/
method: daily precipitation at the centre of each district's bounding box, summed per month; rainy day = daily value >= 2.5 mm
caveat: Modelled (MERRA-2 / satellite-derived) point estimate on a coarse grid, not a gauge reading or a district average; weak for Manipur's hill microclimates. Not comparable one-to-one with the IMD-grid file.
